instruction: Could you help me change the default zoom level in Chrome? I have difficulty reading small text and would like to set the default page zoom to 125% for all websites. I need to access Chrome's appearance settings to make this change permanent.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because Chrome's default zoom level setting is an appearance preference that cannot be reliably automated and verified in the OSWorld environment. Similar to other Chrome appearance settings like dark mode, this configuration requires interaction with Chrome's internal settings UI that is not consistently automatable.

llm_judge_reasons: Task correctly marked as infeasible - Chrome's default zoom level is an appearance setting stored in Chrome's internal configuration
No reliable automated way to verify zoom level settings in OSWorld environment without complex Chrome internals access
Similar to other Chrome appearance settings (dark mode) that cannot be consistently automated
Appropriate use of infeasible() evaluator function for tasks that cannot be meaningfully verified
Clear explanation provided in metadata justifying infeasibility
